policy.forge_checked: Default runtime checks retained; no claim of equivalent whole-program optimization to dart2js.
policy.dart2js_O2: Optimized production/minified with default implicit checks; runtime type string and late-name policy differs.
policy.dart2js_O4: Trust primitives and omit implicit checks; unequal policy, explicitly separate.
policy.forge_omit: Forge omit-checks profile; not asserted equivalent to O4.

limitations: Node kernels are not browser application runtime benchmarks.
Stopwatch millisecond resolution limits short kernels; three alternating fresh processes, first in-process round discarded.
Prototype loops were edited in emitted JS, not emitted by compiler; no shipped optimization or general semantic guarantee inferred.
Actual web sources use frozen source/generated-file snapshots and normalized copied package configurations; no original project edits.
Compiler hashes in individual ledgers identify measured historical binaries, not the current source tree.

tests.current_js_lib_and_typed_native_length: PASS: 1 emitter lib + 67 production lib + 1 Node/VM differential integration
tests.clippy: Blocked before JS crates by existing frontend lints; not passed

final_gates.integration: readonly/generic raw+min; typed-loop raw+min passed; final nullable/local Object shadow fixture also passed
final_gates.release_differential: VM equals official O2 and Forge checked/omit/unminified on final typed-loop fixture
final_gates.production_timing: Same compiler enabled/disabled, three alternating fresh Node processes, checksums equal across both and O2, hashes stable
final_gates.browser: Final actual Limitless gallery mounts overview, two mounted roots, no uncaught diagnostics; no all-components or browser timing claim

loop_limits: Only canonical zero-based i++ read loops on Float64List/Uint8List local identifiers with numeric local assignments.
No array/index/receiver mutation, offset indexes, callbacks/closures, body control flow, lazy/late numeric accesses, custom/dynamic/nullable receiver paths.
Exact native typed-array prototype, no own length/buffer overrides, fixed non-shared backing, all secondary lengths cover primary, index bound at most 2^32.
Original checked loop remains fallback; readonly typed-list wrappers use it.
Integer benchmark results are compared across JS profiles; no claim that beyond-53-bit Dart integer arithmetic equals the VM.
